property_summary: For any caller who is the contract owner and any address value newRoundImplementation, calling updateRoundImplementation(newRoundImplementation) results in c.roundImplementation() equaling the passed newRoundImplementation (the reference always stores the provided value; the mutant only allows zero and therefore will differ for non-zero inputs).
change_summary: Invert the require to only permit setting roundImplementation to the zero address (reject non-zero addresses), causing different stored value after calls.
